summary: Democratic state Rep. James Talarico and Republican Attorney General Ken Paxton, who ousted Sen. John Cornyn in the primary with Trump's backing, are essentially tied, with an Emerson poll at 48 to 46 for Talarico and a Fox News poll at 49 each. KBTX reports spending has passed 500 million dollars, with Republicans attacking Talarico on faith, gender and taxes and Democrats attacking Paxton's impeachment and handling of a child predator case.

issues.why: Economy tops Texas voters' concerns at 39 percent, and Paxton says Talarico voted for a state income tax and would tax tips, overtime and Social Security.
Democratic ads cite Paxton's 2023 impeachment for bribery and abuse of power and a light plea deal in the Hoffman child assault case.
Republican ads replay Talarico saying God is nonbinary and there are six biological sexes, which he now calls cringey.
Immigration ranks second among likely voters' top issues in a state with a long border.
Talarico leads Hispanic voters 64 to 34 in the Fox News poll, and a Cruz aligned PAC is targeting Hispanic Christians in Spanish.

storylines.title: Fox News poll shows a 49 to 49 tie
storylines.what: Paxton gained among rural voters, suburban women and Cornyn primary backers to erase Talarico's September lead, while the two sparred over whether to debate.

storylines.title: Emerson poll has Talarico up 2
storylines.what: Emerson found Talarico at 48 and Paxton at 46 with Libertarian voters possibly decisive, as early voting opened with record turnout in big counties.

storylines.title: Spending passes 500 million dollars
storylines.what: Musk's Texas PAC and Thune aligned groups have poured hundreds of millions into ads, while a Talarico ad calls the Hoffman plea an Epstein style sweetheart deal.

storylines.title: Pro Cruz PAC targets Hispanic Christians
storylines.what: Truth and Courage PAC launched a seven figure Spanish language ad calling Talarico a wolf in sheep's clothing over comments on gender and God.

storylines.title: False mental hospital rumor about Talarico
storylines.what: The Texas Tribune reported Paxton allies spread a false claim that Talarico was in an Ohio mental facility, while Paxton ran ads calling him mentally fragile and the facility said he was never a patient.

storylines.title: Paxton's King James ad
storylines.what: Paxton released an AI made ad of Talarico scribbling in a Bible over his gender comments, and Talarico ran an ad with a former Paxton aide whose claims led to impeachment.

events.title: The debate standoff
events.prompt: No debate is scheduled, the race is tied, and one side has dared the other to debate on Fox News. What does the campaign do?

opts.label: Dare him on Fox
opts.say: Challenge the opponent to debate on conservative home turf and call any refusal hiding.

opts.label: Debate on fair terms
opts.say: Agree to debate under neutral conditions and a statewide broadcaster.

opts.label: Skip the hostile media
opts.say: Decline a network debate and reach voters through rallies and friendly outlets.

events.title: Faith and gender comments
events.prompt: Ads in English and Spanish replay past comments that God is nonbinary and there are six biological sexes. How does the campaign respond?

opts.label: Stand by the theology
opts.say: Defend the point that God defies human categories and call the ads hateful.

opts.label: Admit and move on
opts.say: Call the old comments cringey, talk about personal faith and pivot to costs.

opts.label: Make it the closer
opts.say: Spend heavily reminding Hispanic Christian voters of the comments in the final week.

events.title: Impeachment and the Hoffman case
events.prompt: Ads hit the attorney general's impeachment and a short sentence for a man who assaulted a child, while his office says the victim would not testify again. How is it handled?

opts.label: Make him the issue
opts.say: Run on the Epstein style sweetheart deal and his own party's impeachment.

opts.label: Clean government pitch
opts.say: Raise ethics through a broad anticorruption plan without leaning on the child case.

opts.label: Defend and counter
opts.say: Explain the plea was needed to protect the child and call the attacks smears from the left.

events.title: Income tax charge
events.prompt: The Republican says the Democrat voted for a state income tax and would tax tips, overtime and Social Security. What is the tax message?

opts.label: Tax the rich
opts.say: Argue billionaires and big donors like Musk should pay more while working families pay less.

opts.label: No new taxes pledge
opts.say: Promise no income tax and no tax on tips or overtime and call the attack false.

opts.label: Hammer the income tax
opts.say: Make the income tax vote the centerpiece of the closing ads.

ads.theme: Calls Paxton's handling of the Hoffman case an Epstein style sweetheart deal for a child predator.
Spanish language ad calling Talarico a wolf in sheep's clothing over comments on God and gender.
Musk funded ads saying Talarico would charge parents with child abuse over gender transitions.
Says Paxton let child predators off the hook and was impeached by his own party.

regions.name: Houston metro
regions.note: Democratic Harris and Fort Bend against Republican Montgomery and Brazoria in the biggest metro.

regions.name: Dallas Fort Worth
regions.note: Blue Dallas plus swing suburbs where suburban women may decide the race.

regions.name: Austin and San Antonio
regions.note: Talarico's central Texas base and the fastest growing Democratic region.

regions.name: Border and Rio Grande Valley
regions.note: Heavily Hispanic counties that shifted right in 2024 and are a top target for both sides.

regions.name: West Texas and Panhandle
regions.note: Oil and farm country that is overwhelmingly Republican.

regions.name: East Texas
regions.note: Rural and small city counties that are deeply Republican outside Beaumont.
